art_direction: Illustrated environmental storytelling, rich-but-uncluttered garden, existing Brainroot original mascots and Be Vietnam Pro typography.
background_original: AI-generated one-piece 1672x941 background; text, CTAs, navigation and mascots NOT baked into the image.
limitations: Three background layers are approximated by transparent horizontal masks, not true object-layer illustration.
Subtle (3–12 px) parallax only. Large moves expose gaps or repeated scenery.
Mascots are whole raster illustrations within Canva-export SVG; not independent limb rigs.
No original Be Vietnam Pro font binaries bundled. Web demo loads it from Google Fonts when online; system fallback otherwise.
